The files in clang/ are the unmodified Python bindings from LLVM tag
llvmorg-23.1.3 (commit 0d261d1ca552c95a8f007e061c787ac7132fbcbc),
https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/tree/llvmorg-23.1.3/clang/bindings/python/clang.
They are distributed under the license in LICENSE-LLVM.txt. They require a
compatible LLVM 23 libclang shared library; they do not contain that library.
